summary.tldr: Raises the maximum annual GST/HST credit amounts for the 2025-2026 year, then raises them again for five years starting in 2026-2027.
what_it_does: Increases the maximum annual Goods and Services Tax/Harmonized Sales Tax credit amounts by 50% for the 2025-2026 benefit year.
Increases the maximum annual GST/HST credit amounts by 25% starting in the 2026-2027 benefit year, for a five-year period.
summary.background: The bill amends the Income Tax Act. It was introduced in the House of Commons on 28 January 2026 and given first reading.
